const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboCasa365 OrganizeCoffeeCondiments remote arm controller.
+
+The episode is controlled through rcb_client. All targets are derived from
+live RGB-D camera calibration and measured robot proprioception.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left",
+           "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"]
+LAYOUT = ["eef_right_x", "eef_right_y", "eef_right_z"]
+
+
+def connect():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def state(r):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    p = o.meta["proprio"]
+    vals = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    return o, vals
+
+
+def command(r, q=None, grip=-1., base=(0., 0., 0.), torso=0., mode=-1.,
+            seconds=1., cameras=CAMERAS, video="none", note=""):
+    o, v = state(r)
+    if q is None:
+        q = np.array([v[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / r.spec()["control_dt"])))
+    a = np.zeros((n, 13), dtype=float)
+    a[:, :7] = q
+    a[:, 7] = grip
+    a[:, 8:11] = base
+    a[:, 11] = torso
+    a[:, 12] = mode
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=cameras, video=video,
+                   include_depth=True, note=note)
+    p = res.meta["proprio"]
+    ix = {k:i for i,k in enumerate(p["layout"])}
+    end = {k: p["now"][i] for k,i in ix.items() if k.startswith("eef_right_")}
+    print({"time_left_s":res.meta.get("time_left_s"), "steps":res.meta.get("control_steps"),
+           "eef":end, "done":res.done, "reason":res.meta.get("reason")})
+    res.save("/app/output/latest")
+    return res
+
+
+def cv_depth_to_world(obs, camera, u, v):
+    """Deproject one observed pixel using that response's calibration."""
+    d = obs.depth[camera]
+    if d.ndim == 3:
+        d = d[-1]
+    z = float(d[int(v), int(u)])
+    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    p = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1], -z, 1.])
+    return z, (T @ p)[:3]
+
+
+def main():
+    r = connect()
+    o, v = state(r)
+    print("time_left_s", o.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    print("eef", [v["eef_right_x"], v["eef_right_y"], v["eef_right_z"]])
+    print("q", [v[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1,8)])
+    print("saved initial observation to /app/output/latest")
+    o.save("/app/output/latest")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
